Olivia (Support): Flagging GreenCart ticket: embeddings endpoint returns 1536-dim vectors for batched calls but their pipeline expects 4096 and fails downstream. Single-inputs return 4096 as expected. Error: "vector length mismatch expected 4096 got 1536". They started seeing this after enabling SDK auto-batching.

GreenCart Ops: This started around our peak traffic window. We did not change our consumer. Using model alias 'embed-xl'. Example request via SDK (node): embed.embedMany([a,b,c]) -> boom. Single embed(a) -> ok. Billing spike also noted.

Diego (ML Eng): can you paste raw request/response or transcript? Alias 'embed-xl' could map to older large model (4096) and a newer cost-optimized variant (1536). Interesting that single-input yields the 4096 path; maybe routing policy prefers low-latency for small requests.

Olivia (Support): pasted minimal repro: 
```bash
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model":"embed-xl", "input":["item1","item2"], "client_request_id":"gc-pt-221" }
```
response header and payload snippet: 
```json
{"model":"embed-xl-slim","data":[[...1536 floats...],[...]]}
```
single input response: 
```json
{"model":"embed-xl-legacy","data":[[...4096 floats...]]}
```

Hannah (SRE): config-bot, pull recent routing rule changes for embed-xl alias and any SDK auto-batch feature flags pushed last 14 days.

config-bot: recent entries: 2027-03-02 alias-split embed-xl (added embed-xl-slim), 2027-03-05 routing tweak: prefer_low_latency_for_single=true, 2027-03-07 sdk-feature auto_batch_v2 rollout.

Diego (ML Eng): repro locally with SDK auto_batch enabled: N=1 -> embed-xl-legacy (4096). N>=2 -> embed-xl-slim (1536). So alias routing yields different variants by batch size. That's exactly the cause.

Olivia (Support): GreenCart is production-critical and cannot accept 1536 vectors. They want immediate remediation and an explanation for the billing spike.

Hannah (SRE): Short-term ops options: 1) ask GreenCart to pin model to embed-xl-legacy in the request (quick fix), 2) apply an account-level alias override mapping embed-xl -> embed-xl-legacy, 3) ask them to disable SDK auto-batching (client-side). Which do they prefer?

GreenCart Ops: We want the platform to behave consistently without code changes. Please apply the account override. Also we need a runbook and a customer-friendly check to detect this automatically.

Hannah (SRE): applying override now. Patch: 
PATCH /v1/accounts/GREENCART/config 
{ "alias_overrides": {"embed-xl":"embed-xl-legacy"} }

Applied. Verifying: re-run failing batch call -> response now shows embed-xl-legacy and 4096 dims.

config-bot: change-id cfg-67211 applied by hannah at 2027-03-09T09:14:22Z.

Diego (ML Eng): guidance for Support to give customer: 1) pin model id in requests if you have strict downstream dims, 2) at startup call GET /v1/models/<id>/meta to fetch embedding_dimension and cache it, 3) consider checking the response model field or an SDK-exposed embedding_dimension header to validate shape before ingesting. Example metadata call: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/embed-xl-legacy/meta
# => {"id":"embed-xl-legacy","embedding_dimension":4096}
```

Olivia (Support): can we add the embedding_dimension in the top-level response now? That would make client-side checks trivial.

Diego (ML Eng): agreed. Filing ENG-10112: add embedding_dimension as top-level response field and a response header 'X-Embedding-Dimension'. Also filing ENG-10113: SDK change to expose model meta fetch helpers and make auto-batching opt-in, default=false.

Hannah (SRE): operational follow-ups: ENG-10114 audit routing policies so alias->variant changes by batch size are either avoided or clearly documented; ENG-10115 implement per-account alias override audit trail and better UI to request overrides from Support. I'll own those.

Riley (Docs): I'll update the public FAQ and onboarding guide with a paragraph: "Aliases may route to different model variants depending on request shape (batch size) and routing policies. If your downstream requires a fixed embedding dimension, pin a model variant or use the metadata endpoint to assert dims programmatically." Also will add example CLI/SDK snippets and a small runbook "RB-embeddings-shape-check" for customers.

Olivia (Support): Billing spike: GreenCart saw higher cost because embed-xl-slim was a newer cost-optimized SKU? They reported a delta of +12% token cost but their invoice shows a +60% spike. Could that be from retries?

Hannah (SRE): two contributors: 1) embed-xl-slim per-request pricing differs for batch handling and overheads can increase charge calculations for multi-row calls, 2) SDK auto-batch may have retried requests when receiving unexpected shapes causing duplicated calls. I'll open BILL-2304 to investigate and propose credits. For immediate support, offer a courtesy credit while billing team investigates.

GreenCart Ops: Please do. They accepted temporary override and would like a short customer-facing checklist to detect this in the future.

Riley (Docs): Drafting checklist for customer ops: 
- At startup call GET /v1/models/<model-id>/meta and assert embedding_dimension.
- On each embeddings response check the model field and/or X-Embedding-Dimension header before writing to vector DB.
- If using SDK auto-batching, set autoBatch=false if your downstream requires a fixed dim.
- If mismatch detected, pause ingestion and contact Support with client_request_id and the request payload.
I'll attach this doc and a one-page runbook link in the support reply.

Diego (ML Eng): note for engineering: add server-side warning logs when alias resolution returns a variant with dimension != alias_typical_dimension (ENG-10116). This will help alert SRE/Support earlier.

Olivia (Support): TL;DR for ticket: root cause = alias routing resolves to a different variant for batched requests due to recent routing policy and SDK auto-batching; immediate mitigation = account alias override applied; short-term workarounds = pin model id, disable auto-batching, fetch metadata; owners: Hannah (override + billing ticket), Diego (ENG feature tickets), Riley (docs + runbook). Sending reply to GreenCart and closing once billing credit confirmed. :white_check_mark:

config-bot: support:ticket:81590 created and linked to ENG-10112 ENG-10113 ENG-10114 ENG-10115 BILL-2304.

Hannah (SRE): override confirmed and monitoring for 48h. I'll follow up on BILL-2304.

Riley (Docs): PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3554 (FAQ + runbook).

Diego (ML Eng): thanks team. Also adding a short internal note for product: consider making alias behavior more explicit in the Console when alias maps to variants with different dims.

Olivia (Support): closing ticket pending billing resolution. Good work everyone.
